title: Natural extension of a finite-stage tensor comparison
statement: Let I,F,i₀,i,B₀,C₀,P,Q and the initial P-action be as in the tensor diagram construction, and let φ₀:B₀→C₀ be an F(i₀)-algebra map. Suppose ψ:B_i⊗_P Q→C_i restricts on B_i to φ_i=id⊗φ₀. Suppose given P-actions on B_j, diagrams D,E on J={j | i≤j}, equivalences d_j:D_j≃B_j⊗_P Q and c_j:E_j≃C_j, P-linear initial transitions βs_j with canonical underlying maps, and canonical source and target transition identities. There exists a natural transformation α:D→E whose conjugate χ_j=c_j α_j d_j⁻¹ restricts on B_j to φ_j=id⊗φ₀, and whose value on 1⊗q is the canonical C_i→C_j image of ψ(1⊗q). No pushout property is asserted.

source.place: Tags 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat), proof of (3), construction of Ψ; 00DD (lemma-tensor-product-colimit), canonical tensor legs. Online source read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Let q_i:Q→C_i be ψ composed with the right tensor inclusion, and q_j the canonical C_i→C_j transition composed with q_i. Give C_j the P-action through φ_j composed with P→B_j. The equality hψ and the tensor balancing relation identify q_i(algebraMap(p)) with φ_i(algebraMap(p)). The P-linearity of βs_j and the tensor identity e_ij φ_i=φ_j βs_j then show q_j is a P-algebra map. Define χ_j as the actual tensor product map of the P-algebra maps φ_j:B_j→C_j and q_j:Q→C_j. Thus χ_j(b⊗q)=φ_j(b)q_j(q). Canonical tensor transitions commute with φ, and q_j is compatible with transitions by functoriality. Induction on tensors proves χ is compatible with the prescribed D and E transitions. Conjugating by d_j and c_j therefore defines a natural transformation. Its left inclusion identity follows by setting q=1; its Q-coordinate identity follows by setting b=1. The construction uses no injectivity, flatness, or nonzero-ring assumption.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formal elaboration of step 2 of the parent finite-stage tensor construction, using the cited tensor universal properties.

theorem exists_comparison_tensor_natural_extension
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v})
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPi : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (ψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ((↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q) →+* (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (hψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ψ.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj i) (F.obj i)) φ₀).toRingHom) :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
      ∀ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        ∀ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y}),
          ∀ (d : ∀ j : J,
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∀ (c : ∀ j : J,
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
                  ∀ (βs : ∀ j : J,
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPi
                    letI := aPs j
                    (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                      (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αij : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj j.val :=
                      { (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj j.val ↦ f s)
                            (F.map_comp (homOfLE hi) (homOfLE j.property)).symm }
                    (βs j).toRingHom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αij (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) →
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aPs k
                    ∃ β : (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                        (↥(F.obj k.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀),
                      (let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm };
                        β.toRingHom =
                          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk
                            (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                      (d k).toRingHom.comp (D.map r).hom =
                        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map β (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                          (d j).toRingHom) →
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm }
                    (c k).toRingHom.comp (E.map r).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom) →
                  ∃ (α : D ⟶ E),
                  (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  ((c j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)).comp
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
                      (A := ↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj j.val) (F.obj j.val))
                      φ₀).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ (j : J) (q : Q),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPi
                    letI := aPs j
                    let αij : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj j.val :=
                      { (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj j.val ↦ f s)
                            (F.map_comp (homOfLE hi) (homOfLE j.property)).symm }
                    c j ((α.app j).hom ((d j).symm (1 ⊗ₜ[P] q))) =
                      Algebra.TensorProduct.map αij (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)
                        (ψ (1 ⊗ₜ[P] q)))
